findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "ai_render_check" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Show what AI crawlers that don't run JavaScript (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot) actually see on a page: readable words in the raw HTML, title, meta de…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pagespeed_check, schema_check, gsc_query_classifier, ai_render_check, agent_readiness · Private data: agent_readiness · Public sink: ai_crawler_check · Destructive: pagespeed_check, ai_render_check, agent_readiness.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pagespeed_check, schema_check, gsc_query_classifier, ai_render_check, agent_readiness · Private data: agent_readiness · Public sink: ai_crawler_check · Destructive: pagespeed_check, ai_render_check, agent_readiness

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
